assets.name: floor
assets.prompt: One square data center floor tile seen from the side for a 2D platformer: top edge is a light grey steel lip, body is dark slate concrete with small rivets. Fully opaque, fills the whole square edge to edge so it tiles seamlessly left and right.

assets.name: raised-floor
assets.prompt: One square raised access floor tile seen from the side: perforated light grey panel on top with a row of small vent holes, dark pedestal struts below. Fully opaque, fills the whole square and tiles seamlessly left and right.

assets.name: platform
assets.prompt: One square segment of a steel catwalk platform seen from the side: yellow and black safety stripe on the top edge, grey grating below, only the top third of the square is filled, the rest transparent. Tiles seamlessly left and right.

assets.name: tray
assets.prompt: One square segment of an overhead yellow ladder style cable tray seen from the side, with bundled blue and orange network cables lying in it. Only the top half of the square is filled, bottom half transparent. Tiles seamlessly left and right.

assets.name: ladder
assets.prompt: One square segment of a vertical grey steel ladder seen from the front: two side rails and two rungs. Transparent between rails. Tiles seamlessly up and down.

assets.name: rack-ok
assets.prompt: One tall server rack front, narrow and tall, dark charcoal frame, stacked 1U servers with small green status LEDs, perforated door edge. Healthy and online. Fills the full height.

assets.name: rack-fault
assets.prompt: The same tall server rack front, dark charcoal frame, stacked 1U servers, one server pulled slightly out with a bright red fault LED and a loose cable. Fills the full height.

assets.name: exit-closed
assets.prompt: A data hall exit door seen from the front, grey steel double door with a small window, closed, red status light above the frame. Fills the full canvas.

assets.name: exit-open
assets.prompt: The same data hall exit door seen from the front, slid open showing a bright corridor beyond, green status light above the frame. Fills the full canvas.

assets.name: checkpoint-off
assets.prompt: A slim network status beacon on a pole, grey housing with an unlit round lamp on top. Narrow, centered, standing on the bottom edge.

assets.name: checkpoint-on
assets.prompt: The same slim network status beacon on a pole with its round lamp lit bright green and pulsing: frames go from dim green glow to bright glow and back.

assets.name: cable-snag
assets.prompt: A tangled loop of loose orange and blue network cable lying on the floor as a trip hazard, low and wide, touching the bottom edge. Frame 2 shows the loop shifted slightly.

assets.name: coolant
assets.prompt: A small blue coolant canister with a white cross label, a health pickup. Frames bob the canister up and down by a small amount with a soft highlight moving across it.

assets.name: health-full
assets.prompt: A small bright red heart shaped health segment icon with a dark outline.

assets.name: health-empty
assets.prompt: The same small heart shaped health segment icon but empty, dark grey with a dark outline.

assets.name: task-open
assets.prompt: A small empty checkbox icon, light grey square with dark outline.

assets.name: task-done
assets.prompt: A small checkbox icon with a bright green check mark, dark outline.

assets.name: star-on
assets.prompt: A gold five pointed star icon with a dark outline and a small shine.

assets.name: star-off
assets.prompt: An empty grey five pointed star icon with a dark outline.

assets.name: title
assets.prompt: Game title logo with the visible text "MIDCREEK HERO" in bold chunky pixel letters, lime and orange hi vis colors with dark outline, a small blue hard hat above the first letter, a thin server rack silhouette band behind the text. The visible text must be exactly "MIDCREEK HERO" with no other words.

assets.name: button
assets.prompt: A wide rectangular menu button frame, dark slate fill with a lime green beveled border, empty center with no text.

assets.name: heat-vent
assets.prompt: A floor heat exhaust grille seen from the side, dark steel slats glowing from dim orange to bright orange red across the frames.

assets.name: heat-plume
assets.prompt: A tall column of hot air rising from a floor vent, drawn as wavy orange and pale yellow pixel ripples, semi solid, different wave phase in each frame.

assets.name: psu
assets.prompt: A small server power supply unit module, grey metal box with a fan grille and a green handle, seen from the side.

assets.name: dimm
assets.prompt: A small green memory module stick with black chips and gold contacts, seen at a slight angle.

assets.name: cable-port
assets.prompt: A wall mounted network patch panel port block with three empty rectangular jacks and a dangling unplugged blue cable.

assets.name: moving-snag
assets.prompt: A writhing loose bundle of orange and blue cables sliding on the floor, low and wide, the loops shifting shape in each frame.

assets.name: spark-arc
assets.prompt: A horizontal electrical arc of crackling bright blue and white lightning between two points, a different jagged path in each frame.

assets.name: spark-emitter
assets.prompt: A damaged electrical junction box with an exposed copper terminal and yellow hazard stripes.

assets.name: lift
assets.prompt: A small industrial scissor lift platform top seen from the side: yellow steel deck with black and yellow hazard edge.

assets.name: switch-off
assets.prompt: A network switch control panel on a short stand with a large red unlit push button and a dark status screen.

assets.name: switch-on
assets.prompt: The same network switch control panel with a large green lit push button and a bright green status screen.

assets.name: drone
assets.prompt: A small hovering security drone with two rotors and a red scanning eye, rotors in a different blur position in each frame.
